# anecdotes_playbook_library (Data Source)

Lists the trigger events a playbook step can subscribe to, so a `trigger_event` on
`anecdotes_playbook` can be looked up rather than guessed.

Use `trigger_value` as the `trigger_event` of a step: it is the event's
`trigger_key` when the event declares one, and its `event_type` otherwise.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every trigger event available to this account.
data "anecdotes_playbook_library" "all" {}

# Only the control events that can be used right now.
data "anecdotes_playbook_library" "control_events" {
  category       = "control"
  available_only = true
}

output "control_trigger_values" {
  value = [for e in data.anecdotes_playbook_library.control_events.events : e.trigger_value]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `available_only` (Boolean) Return only the events available to this account.
- `category` (String) Filter events by category (case-insensitive), for example "control" or "risk".

### Read-Only

- `events` (Attributes List) List of trigger events matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of trigger events matching the filters.

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) The part of the platform the event belongs to.
- `coming_soon_actions` (List of String) The action types announced for this event but not yet available.
- `description` (String) What the event describes.
- `event_text` (String) The human-readable name of the event.
- `event_type` (String) The platform event that fires the step.
- `is_available` (Boolean) Whether the event is available to this account.
- `required_changed_field` (String) The field whose change the event reports, when it reports one.
- `supported_actions` (List of String) The action types a step subscribing to this event can perform.
- `trigger_key` (String) The qualified form of the event when it distinguishes a changed field, for example FindingUpdated:severity. Empty when the event does not declare one.
- `trigger_value` (String) The value to use as a step's trigger_event: trigger_key when set, event_type otherwise.
